payload.title: The edge release's cosign installer default moved from cosign v2 to v3 in a dependency bump (#284, 2026-06-10), and cosign v3 ignores the --output-signature and --output-certificate flags the signing steps use, so Create GitHub Release fails after all three archives are built (agent-v2.0.0-rc.7); no pull-request job signs anything, so the break was latent
evidence: .github/workflows/edge-agent-release.yml:352 (the cosign installer step; before this change it passed no cosign-release, so the installer default v3.0.6 applied)
.github/workflows/edge-agent-release.yml:374-377 (cosign sign-blob with --output-certificate and --output-signature: the legacy outputs cosign v3 ignores when it writes a Sigstore bundle)
.github/workflows/edge-agent-release.yml:473-476 (the manifest signature uses the same legacy outputs)
tools/gates/sens-enterprise-validation.ts:719-720 (the release gate pins the manifest's .sig and .pem fields, so the file contract is part of the release gate)
docs/runbooks/edge-gateway-ota.md:39-40 (the operator verification command consumes the .pem and .sig files)
payload.rule_violated: A tool a release depends on is pinned to the line whose output contract the release consumes; an update of the action that installs it must not move the tool's major version unnoticed, and the contract is detectable before a tag exists.
payload.notes: Run 40685042259 (tag agent-v2.0.0-rc.7, 7a6320973): Release ref contract, Sens enterprise validation and the three Build jobs passed; Create GitHub Release failed in Sign release artifacts with cosign with 'create bundle file: open : no such file or directory' after the warnings that --output-signature and --output-certificate are ignored with the new bundle format; nothing was published. Close condition: the installer step pins cosign-release v2.6.5 (the last v2 line, which writes the .sig and .pem files), the version is 2.0.0-rc.8 so a new tag can be cut (a pushed tag is not moved), and tests/invariants/edge-release-cosign-contract.spec.ts fails when the pin is removed or moved to v3 while the workflow signs with the legacy outputs.
